ruleDefinitions.name: GCP Access Policy Deleted
ruleDefinitions.description:
Detects when an access policy that is applied to a GCP cloud resource is deleted.
An adversary would be able to remove access policies to gain access to a GCP cloud resource.
 Note: Unmapped fields: data.protoPayload.authorizationInfo.permission, data.protoPayload.authorizationInfo.granted, data.protoPayload.serviceName

sequences.query: ((data.protoPayload.authorizationInfo.permission = "accesscontextmanager\.accessPolicies\.delete" OR data.protoPayload.authorizationInfo.permission = "accesscontextmanager\.accessPolicies\.accessLevels\.delete" OR data.protoPayload.authorizationInfo.permission = "accesscontextmanager\.accessPolicies\.accessZones\.delete" OR data.protoPayload.authorizationInfo.permission = "accesscontextmanager\.accessPolicies\.authorizedOrgsDescs\.delete") AND data.protoPayload.authorizationInfo.granted = "true" AND data.protoPayload.serviceName = "accesscontextmanager\.googleapis\.com")
